import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static int modularInverse(int n) {
        long exponent = MOD - 2;
        long result = 1;
        long base = n;
        while (exponent > 0) {
            if ((exponent & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % MOD;
            }
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exponent >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        int size = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        int[][] matrix = new int[size][size];
        for (int row = 0; row < size; row++) {
            String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
            for (int col = 0; col < size; col++) {
                matrix[row][col] = Integer.parseInt(parts[col]);
            }
        }

        List<Integer> maskH = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> maskH2 = new ArrayList<>();
        int halfH = (size + 1) / 2;
        int halfH2 = size - halfH;
        int inv100 = modularInverse(100);

        int totalMasks = 1 << size;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < totalMasks; mask++) {
            int countBits = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            if (countBits == halfH) maskH.add(mask);
            if (countBits == halfH2) maskH2.add(mask);
        }

        int totalStatesH = 1 << (size * halfH);
        int totalStatesH2 = 1 << (size * halfH2);
        long[] probability = new long[totalStatesH];
        long[] probability2 = new long[totalStatesH2];

        // Process first half
        for (int subsetMask = 0; subsetMask < totalStatesH; subsetMask++) {
            long probProduct = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < size * halfH; j++) {
                int rowIdx = j / size;
                int colIdx = j % size;
                if (((subsetMask >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    probProduct = (probProduct * ((long) matrix[rowIdx][colIdx] * inv100) % MOD) % MOD;
                } else {
                    probProduct = (probProduct * ((long) (100 - matrix[rowIdx][colIdx]) * inv100) % MOD) % MOD;
                }
            }
            int possibleStates = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < maskH.size(); j++) {
                int maskVal = maskH.get(j);
                List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int k = 0; k < size; k++) {
                    if (((maskVal >> k) & 1) == 1) v.add(k);
                }
                do {
                    boolean valid = true;
                    for (int k = 0; k < v.size(); k++) {
                        int a = k * size + v.get(k);
                        if (((subsetMask >> a) & 1) == 0) {
                            valid = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (valid) {
                        possibleStates |= (1 << j);
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(v));
            }
            probability[possibleStates] = (probability[possibleStates] + probProduct) % MOD;
        }

        // Process second half
        for (int subsetMask = 0; subsetMask < totalStatesH2; subsetMask++) {
            long probProduct = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < size * halfH2; j++) {
                int rowIdx = j / size + halfH;
                int colIdx = j % size;
                if (((subsetMask >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    probProduct = (probProduct * ((long) matrix[rowIdx][colIdx] * inv100) % MOD) % MOD;
                } else {
                    probProduct = (probProduct * ((long) (100 - matrix[rowIdx][colIdx]) * inv100) % MOD) % MOD;
                }
            }
            int possibleStates = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < maskH.size(); j++) {
                int maskVal = maskH.get(j);
                List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int k = 0; k < size; k++) {
                    if (((maskVal >> k) & 1) == 0) v.add(k);
                }
                do {
                    boolean valid = true;
                    for (int k = 0; k < v.size(); k++) {
                        int a = k * size + v.get(k);
                        if (((subsetMask >> a) & 1) == 0) {
                            valid = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (valid) {
                        possibleStates |= (1 << j);
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(v));
            }
            probability2[possibleStates] = (probability2[possibleStates] + probProduct) % MOD;
        }

        // Inclusion-Exclusion on probability2
        for (int i = 0; i < maskH.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << maskH.size()); j++) {
                if (((j >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                    probability2[j] = (probability2[j] + probability2[j ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        long answer = 0;
        int totalStates = 1 << maskH.size();
        for (int i = 0; i < totalStates; i++) {
            long val = (long) probability[i] * probability2[(totalStates - 1) ^ i] % MOD;
            answer = (answer + val) % MOD;
        }

        System.out.println((MOD + 1 - answer) % MOD);
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> v) {
        int i = v.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && v.get(i) >= v.get(i + 1)) i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = v.size() - 1;
        while (v.get(j) <= v.get(i)) j--;
        Collections.swap(v, i, j);
        int left = i + 1;
        int right = v.size() - 1;
        while (left < right) {
            Collections.swap(v, left, right);
            left++;
            right--;
        }
        return true;
    }
}
